mails.subject: Weekend note: candidates for your open roles
mails.body:
Hi there,

Sorry to write on a Saturday evening, this is the only time I get to catch up on outreach.

I am a recruiter at Harbourline Talent, and we place people in operations, community management and customer success across the Nordic region. At the moment we have several candidates who would be a good match for a coworking or hospitality environment, including a community manager with six years of experience in Copenhagen.

Here is how we work:
- We send you two or three anonymised profiles.
- You tell us if you would like to meet any of them.
- We only invoice if you hire, at 15 percent of the first year salary.

We do not need a brief to start. If there is nothing open right now, I would be happy to keep you in mind for later in the year.

I have also attached our short guide to hiring in the Danish market in the link below.
harbourline-talent.example/guide

If you are not the right person for this, please forward this message to whoever handles hiring.

Best wishes,
Elise Warren
Senior Recruiter, Harbourline Talent
mails.justification: Recruitment blast offering candidates and fees to a space with no open search. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.

mails.subject: Re : Suite à notre rencontre au salon
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je reviens vers vous suite à mon dernier message.

> Ravi de vous avoir rencontré lors de votre dernier événement, on devrait collaborer.

Je tenais à vous redire à quel point votre lieu m'a marqué. Chez Meridien Impulse, nous accompagnons des communautés et des espaces de travail partagés dans leur développement, et je suis convaincu qu'il existe de belles synergies entre nos deux structures.

Nous ne cherchons rien de précis pour le moment, simplement à nouer des liens, à échanger sur nos pratiques et à voir si des projets communs peuvent naître. Nous avons une approche très souple et nous nous adaptons toujours à nos partenaires.

Seriez-vous disponible pour un appel de quinze minutes la semaine prochaine ? Je peux aussi passer à Copenhague en octobre si cela vous convient.

Dans l'attente de votre retour, je vous souhaite une très belle fin de semaine.

Bien cordialement,
Hugo Verdier
Directeur du développement, Meridien Impulse
meridien-impulse.example

mails.subject: Dev team on demand, no hiring needed
mails.body:
Hi,

sorry for typos, writing this on my phone in the train.

My name is Nils and I run Stackbridge, a small outsourcing company with developers in Poland and Portugal. We build websites, booking tools and mobile apps for businesses that do not want to hire in house.

I saw that your space has a members area and an events page, and I think we could improve both. For example:
- a booking system for rooms and desks that syncs with your calendar
- a members portal with invoices and access cards
- a simple app for your community

Our rate is 45 EUR per hour for senior developers, and we can start with a trial week of 20 hours at half price. Most clients stay with us for years after the trial.

We have worked with more than 80 companies in Europe, from startups to larger firms. I can send a portfolio and a couple of references if that helps.

Would you be open to a short call this week? I am flexible on time.

Best,
Nils Petersen
CEO, Stackbridge
Sent from my iPad
